content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority (SMPA) has its Head Office at 15 Strand Road, Kolkata. These Anchorage Pilot posts are in the Marine Department of the Kolkata Dock System (KDS) of SMPA. The notice is signed by the Dy. Secretary-II for the Secretary.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: SMPA will engage two Anchorage Pilots on a purely contractual basis for a period of three (03) years. Applications are invited from eligible Indian nationals. The nationality condition is "Indian citizens". Essential educational qualification: "Must have Certificate of Competency as Master FG or First Mate (FG) or Second Mate (FG)." The notice names no other degree or experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The upper age limit is 50 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Allowances
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration depends on the Certificate of Competency the candidate holds: The notice lists these allowances and benefits: Mess Allowance of Rs. 350/- per day during the stay on board the vessels at anchor. Uniform Allowance at Rs. 1125/- per month. Uniform washing allowance at Rs. 600/- per month. Indoor and outdoor medical facilities at Centenary Hospital, SMPA, for self and spouse. Medicines, tests or treatment taken outside are not reimbursed, except for treatment of an injury caused by an accident arising out of and in the course of employment. Reimbursement of 25% of the Medical Insurance premium paid to cover the employee and spouse, up to Rs. 5000/- per annum, on documentary proof of payment. TA / DA as admissible on official tour outside Headquarter. On receipt of 7.5% annual increment for continuous 3 years, the contractual employee may be considered for elevation in rank by prefixing "Senior" to the existing designation, apart from a hike in remuneration by 3% more. SMPA accommodation (unfurnished) may be availed on payment of licence fee or rent as applicable, with an advance security deposit equal to one month's rent or licence fee. Contributions to ESI and EPF under the ESI Act, 1948 and the EPF and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, as applicable. SMPA would also pay the employer's contribution.

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms and Posting
content_sections.text: The engagement is provisionally for three (03) years. Renewal is subject to an annual performance review after each calendar year of service. The grading range is A – Outstanding, B – Very Good, C – Good or Satisfactory and D – Poor, and the minimum benchmark is Very Good. Selected candidates will undergo familiarisation training for 02 months, assisting the Pilots at the Anchorage. After the training they must pass an examination before they are issued dispensation to work as Anchorage Pilots (on contract). Selected candidates will first report to the office of Harbour Master (River), Subhas Bhavan, 40, Circular Garden Reach Road, Kolkata - 700043. They may be required to work at any place within the jurisdiction of SMP, Kolkata. Work on a weekly off day or a declared National Holiday in an exigency earns a compensatory day off, with no other compensation. Leave: 15 days per year, with pro-rata deduction for unauthorised absence beyond 15 days. In addition, 10 days of medical leave are allowed during the engagement. Maternity Leave is allowed to female contractual employees as per Circular No. Admn/7478/Medical/E2 dated 22.09.2022. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice. It can be ended on 24 hours' notice for unsatisfactory performance or any act detrimental to the interest of SMPA. No other remunerative occupation, trade, business, private practice or consulting is allowed without the prior written permission of SMPA. Upon selection, a notarized affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of not less than Rs. 10/- must be submitted in the format attached to the notice.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring the duly filled proforma (Annexure-I). You also need the original and one set of self-attested photocopies of each of these documents: Age Proof Certificate (Birth Certificate issued by appropriate Authority/Admit card of Board Examination). Educational and Professional Qualification Certificates/ Mark Sheets. Experience/ Service Certificate(s)/ COC/ CDC etc. Any other relevant certificates and licenses. Photo identity card issued by Govt. of India (Voter/PAN Card/Passport/Driving License etc.) in original. Duly filled in application proforma with a passport sized photograph affixed (Annexure-I). The Annexure-I form asks for your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (with a self-attested copy of proof), addresses, nationality, marital status, religion, educational qualifications with percentage of marks, professional qualification, working experience, phone number and e-mail address. It ends with a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 10:00 A.M. at SMPA's Head Office and attend the walk-in interview. To be considered, you must meet the essential criteria and submit the filled Annexure-I with self-attested photocopies of the relevant documents. All original documents are checked for verification on the interview date. Selected candidates must submit an Antecedent Verification report issued by the appropriate Police Authority and undergo a medical fitness test before joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applying or attending the walk-in interview gives no right or claim to the engagement. SMP, Kolkata reserves the right to cancel or withhold the selection process without assigning any reason. If any application is found to be incorrect or false, even after engagement, the contract is liable to be terminated forthwith. SMPA may run a background check (criminal history, education, employment and personal details) on the selected candidate. Further updates will be posted on SMPA's website, https://smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in/smpk/en/ . SMPA is not responsible if applicants miss information uploaded there. The terms and conditions are indicative only and can be modified from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the SMPA Anchorage Pilot walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 14 December 2026 (Monday), with reporting at 10:00 A.M., at SMPA's Head Office, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata-700001.

faq.question: Q2. How many Anchorage Pilot vacancies are there?
faq.answer: SMPA will engage two (02) Anchorage Pilots for the Marine Department of the Kolkata Dock System.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for SMPA Anchorage Pilot?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Certificate of Competency as Master FG or First Mate (FG) or Second Mate (FG).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an SMPA Anchorage Pilot?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 1,50,000/- consolidated per month for Master FG / First Mate (FG) and Rs. 1,00,000/- consolidated per month for Second Mate (FG). Mess, uniform and uniform washing allowances are paid on top.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled Annexure-I proforma with a photograph affixed. Also bring the original and one self-attested photocopy of your age proof, qualification certificates and mark sheets, experience/service certificates/COC/CDC, other relevant certificates and licences, and a Govt. of India photo identity card.

faq.question: Q7. Is the SMPA Anchorage Pilot job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely contractual engagement for three (03) years, and renewal is subject to an annual performance review with a minimum benchmark of Very Good.

faq.question: Q8. Is there training after selection?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates undergo 02 months of familiarisation training assisting the Pilots at the Anchorage. They must then pass an examination to be issued dispensation to work as Anchorage Pilots (on contract).

faq.question: Q9. What must selected candidates do before joining?
faq.answer: They must submit an Antecedent Verification report from the appropriate Police Authority, undergo a medical fitness test, and submit a notarized affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of not less than Rs. 10/-.
